author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the land of video games getting dragged onto the big screen. Mass effect is one of my favourite game franchises and some troubling signals of it not even being taken seriously from people running it's new TV show has me wondering what even is the point. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Hollywood Is Trying To Ruin Mass Effect Now...
